rulebook: United States FDA Food Labeling Requirements (21 CFR Part 101)
scope: Rulebook Citation & Quotation Verification Test Key

rules.exactQuotation: Ingredients required to be declared on the label or labeling of a food shall be listed by common or usual name in descending order of predominance by weight.
The principal display panel of a food in package form shall bear a declaration of the net quantity of contents.
rules.notes: Requires net quantity on PDP in dual units (avoirdupois ounce and metric).

rules.exactQuotation: A statement of the number of grams of total carbohydrate in a serving shall be expressed to the nearest gram.
rules.notes: Total carbohydrate rounding rules and Daily Value calculation basis.

rules.exactQuotation: All cereal packages must be printed in purple ink.
rules.notes: Invented rule quotation must be rejected and flagged as unverified.
